headword: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}

definitions.explanation: Technology that overlays digital information — such as images, text, or 3D models — onto the real-world environment, typically viewed through a smartphone, tablet, or special glasses.

examples.japanese: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧みた。
examples.english: I tried using an augmented reality app.

examples.japanese: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Augmented reality technology is also being used in the field of education.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧{拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}できる→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: You can experience the world of augmented reality through your smartphone's camera.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{拡張|かくちょう}→拡張：12812_kakuchou⟧ (expansion, augmentation) + ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧ (reality). Often abbreviated as AR in both Japanese and English contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: AR technology
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: AR application
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}する→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧: to experience augmented reality
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: AR-compatible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- VR（⟦{仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}→仮想現実：20409_kasougenjitsu⟧）: virtual reality — creates an entirely artificial environment, unlike AR which overlays digital content on the real world
- MR（{複合現実|ふくごうげんじつ}）: mixed reality — blends real and virtual worlds more seamlessly than AR
- XR: extended reality — an umbrella term covering AR, VR, and MR
